report_topic: Implementation of The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
observations_summary: The audit found significant delays in implementing the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, due to delayed rule notification, lack of comprehensive surveys, and low issuance of Unique ID cards. Key issues included non-establishment of rehabilitation centers, inadequate accessible infrastructure in public spaces and schools, and unsatisfactory performance of special schools due to infrastructure and staffing deficiencies.
